label.purpose: Panel titles and the product name.

code.purpose: Editor, results and anything the database reads or returns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action in a region, such as Run.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:#ededed; color:#0a0a0a; font:500 13px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#cccccc; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(.5px); } .ds-kbd-hint { margin-left:2px; font:11px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color:#555; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action next to a primary, such as Run all or Examples.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius:6px; background:#000; color:#ededed; font:500 13px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#1a1a1a; border-color:#454545; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis inline action, such as Clear or Copy TSV.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; height:28px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#a1a1a1; font:500 12.5px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#1a1a1a; color:#ededed; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field for keys, values and the server URL.
components.css: .ds-input { height:36px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius:6px; background:#000; color:#ededed; font:13px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#8a8a8a; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#454545; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Live connection state in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius:999px; background:#000; color:#ededed; font:13px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-pill:hover { background:#111; border-color:#454545; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#4fca82; } .ds-pill-label { font-weight:500; } .ds-pill-host { font:12px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color:#8a8a8a; }

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Text tab with a white underline when selected.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; border-bottom:1px solid #222; } .ds-tab { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:40px; padding:0 10px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#a1a1a1; font:500 13.5px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color .15s; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color:#ededed; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:8px; right:8px; bottom:-1px; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:#ededed; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3291ff; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-count { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; min-width:20px; height:18px; padding:0 6px; border-radius:999px; background:#1a1a1a; color:#a1a1a1; font-size:11px; }

narrative.overview: A developer's console in the black, hairline-thin idiom of modern deploy dashboards. The page is pure black; working surfaces are near-black panels separated by 1px lines, never by shadow or color. The interface stays silent so the database's answers are the brightest things on screen. Color is a signal, not decoration, and the one signature device is the editor gutter, where each line gets a status dot after it runs.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground with near-black panels and 1px hairlines
White primary buttons with black text; everything else is outlined or ghost
Geist for the interface, Geist Mono for code, data and measurements
Green, red, amber and blue reserved for state
Flat at rest; only floating menus carry a shadow

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red, amber and blue mean query or connection state. Never use them for decoration, emphasis or branding.

rules.name: The One White Button Rule
rules.body: Each region has at most one Paper White button: its primary action (Run, Set, Reconnect).

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is only for code, data and measurements (queries, cell values, timings, URLs, kbd hints), never for decoration.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with a 1px line in Hairline or Hairline Strong. Never use a resting shadow, a colored border or a thicker stripe.

dos: Do keep the page ground Ink Black (#000) and panels Panel Black (#0a0a0a).
Do use Paper White fill only for the single primary action in a region.
Do show real database output verbatim: the exact error text, row counts and timings.
Do separate regions with 1px Hairline lines.
Do keep motion to state changes, at 150–250ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't use green, red, amber or blue for anything but state (The State-Only Color Rule).
Don't add resting shadows, glows or halos around status dots.
Don't use monospace for headings or labels that aren't code or data.
Don't put a grid or line-field texture behind content; the corner crosshair frame is the only ornament.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings.
